THE URBAN DEVELOPMENT PROJECTS (SPECIAL PROVISIONS) ACT, No. 2 OF 1980
Order under Section 2

BY virtue of powers vested in me under Section 2 of the Urban Development Projects (Special Provisions) Act, No. 2 of1980, I, Maithripala Sirisena, President of Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka upon the recommendation of theMinister-in-Charge of the subject of Megapolis and Western Development, being of the opinion that the land specified inthe Schedule I and II hereto is urgently required for the purpose of construction of Public Servants Apartments Complexand for Urban Development Activities related other development activities related to the construction of a Science andTechnology City under the Megapolis and Western Development Project, do by this Order declare that the said lands isrequired for such purpose.
MAITHRIPALA SIRISENA,President.Presidential Secretariat,Colombo,09th May 2017.
SCHEDULE I

Allotment of land depicted as Lot No. “A” in Plan No. CO/DSM/2015/102 dated 23.05.2016 prepared by SurveyorGeneral in respect of land by bearing Assessment No. 265 (portion) of Pelengasthuduwa Road Borella in the village ofBorella (Ward No. 33, Borella North) in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Thibirigasyaya within the MunicipalCouncil limits of Colombo in Colombo District, Western Province containing in extent of 0 Acres, 1 Rood and 0.31Perches (nearly 0.1020 Hecrates).
The boundaries of said allotment are as follows :

North: Pelengasthuduwa Road, the land in Pelengasthuduwa Road of which the Assessment Number couldnot be found, land bearing Assessment No. 249 and Lot No. 1 Preliminary Plan No. 8426 ;East: Lot No. 1 of Preliminary Plan No. 8426 ;South: Land bearing Assessment No. 10/8 and 10/9 of Surpentine Road ;West: Pelengasthuduwa Road.
